annotations.title: Domain WHOIS (RDAP), DNS and email security

description: Who a domain is registered with and since when (RDAP: registrar, created, expires, age, status, nameservers, DNSSEC), its DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) and email setup (provider, SPF and DMARC policy). No registrant personal data. Paid only: up to 3 domains per call for $0.003 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

domains.description: 1-3 domains (a URL or email address is reduced to its domain).

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.
